This report separates the original selected-network-genome analysis from the
new analysis of complete genomes supplied by CheckV. The complete-genome
pipeline retains both trimming filters; the active report uses conservative
trimming only. The external selected-network analysis is historical.

## Analysis setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
base_dir <- "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes/analysis/"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(root.dir = base_dir)

library(tidyverse)
source.files.from.dir <- function(directory) {
  full.path <- file.path(base_dir, directory)
  functions.list <- list.files(
    path = full.path,
    pattern = "*.R",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  sapply(functions.list, source)
  return(invisible(functions.list))
}
source.files.from.dir("stats")
source.files.from.dir("graphing")
source.files.from.dir("misc")

set.seed(seed = 123)
data_dir <-
  "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes_NOT_CODE/data/20261019"
figs_dir <- getOption(
  "coprolite.figs.dir",
  "~/Documents/ucla/research/project_coprolite_viromes_NOT_CODE/figures"
)
max_iter <- 1000
```

## Historical selected-network analysis

The following selected-network-genome analysis was moved from the contig
report without changing its calculations. Its external inputs remain historical
and do not represent regenerated full-pool results.

### Selected-network-genome results

The selected network contigs define a focused genome subset. The analysis
counts all proteins on those contigs as denominators, applies the same
stringent VFDB-hit thresholds, keeps one dominant hit per ORF, and compares
qualifying-hit prevalence across sample groups.

```{r read in vfdb hits on network genomes}
# parse every protein identifier to recover its sample, contig, and ORF.
all_contigs <- read.table(
  paste0(data_dir, "/proteins_all_ids.txt"),
  header = FALSE
  ) 
all_contigs <- all_contigs %>% 
  separate(V1, into = c("ori", "id", "contig"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>% 
  unite(sample, ori, id, sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_replace(sample, "-", "."))
all_contigs <- all_contigs %>%
  separate(contig, into = c("contig_id", "orf_id"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)")

# read the selected network contigs that define the focused subset.
best_contigs <- read.table(
  paste0(data_dir, "/proteins_best_ids.txt"),
  header = FALSE
  )
best_contigs <- best_contigs %>%
  separate(V1, into = c("ori", "id", "contig"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  unite(sample, ori, id, sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_replace(sample, "-", ".")) %>%
  rename(contig_id = contig)

# count proteins on selected contigs to define each sample's denominator.
usable_proteins <- all_contigs %>%
  semi_join(best_contigs,
            by = c("sample" = "sample",
                   "contig_id" = "contig_id"))
all_contig_counts <- usable_proteins %>%
  count(sample, name = "total")

# filter formatted HMMER hits, retain selected contigs, and keep the dominant
# qualifying hit per sample--contig--ORF combination.
hits <- read.csv(
  paste0(data_dir, "/proteins_all_hits_formatted.csv"),
  header = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    full_seq_evalue = as.numeric(full_seq_evalue),
    full_seq_score = as.numeric(full_seq_score),
    full_seq_bias = as.numeric(full_seq_bias)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    full_seq_evalue <= 1e-10,
    full_seq_score >= 25,
    full_seq_score >= 10 * full_seq_bias
  ) %>%
  semi_join(best_contigs,
            by = c("sample" = "sample",
                   "contig_id" = "contig_id")) %>%
  arrange(sample, contig_id, orf_id, full_seq_evalue, desc(full_seq_score)) %>%
  group_by(sample, contig_id, orf_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

hit_counts <- hits %>%
  count(query_name, sample) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(VF_hit = query_name) %>%
  column_to_rownames("VF_hit")

# convert selected-contig hit counts and protein totals to the shared summary
# matrix format.
hit_totals <- hit_counts %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "sample", values_to = "vfdb_count")
vf_hit_counts <- all_contig_counts %>%
  left_join(hit_totals, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(proportion = vfdb_count / total)
vf_hit_counts[is.na(vf_hit_counts)] <- 0
vf_hit_counts <- vf_hit_counts %>%
  select(sample, vfdb_count, total, proportion) %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = value)
vf_hit_counts_t <- as.data.frame(t(vf_hit_counts))
vf_hit_counts_t$group <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(vf_hit_counts_t))
vf_hit_counts_t$country <- sub("^[^.]+\\.([A-Za-z]{3}).*$", "\\1", rownames(vf_hit_counts_t))
```

```{r analyze in vfdb hits on network genomes}
# bootstrap medians of qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected-contig protein.
vf_hit_boot_res <- get_row_median(
  data = vf_hit_counts,
  num_iter = max_iter, 
  row_num = 3,
  cats = c("ind", "pre", "pal")
  )
vf_hit_boot_res_by_country <- get_row_median(
  data = vf_hit_counts,
  num_iter = max_iter, 
  row_num = 3,
  cats = c("AUT", "AWC", "BMS", "ZAF", "ZAP",
           "CHN", "DNK", "ESP", "USA",
           "FJI", "MEX", "MDG", "TZA", "NPL", "PER")
  )
pal_size_vf_hit <- nrow(vf_hit_counts_t %>% filter(group == "pal"))
# balance resampling to the number of paleofecal samples.
pal_size_vf_hit_boot_res_downsample <- get_row_median(
  data = vf_hit_counts,
  num_iter = max_iter, 
  row_num = 3,
  cats = c("ind", "pre", "pal"),
  max_resample = pal_size_vf_hit
  )

# produce group, country, and balanced-group selected-contig violin plots.
vf_hit_voilin <- create_cat_voilins(
  data = vf_hit_boot_res, 
  ci_offset = c(0.15, 0.55, 0.55),
  file_name = "vf_perc_netGen",
  plot_dir = paste0(figs_dir, "/vf"),
  cats_order = c("pal", "pre", "ind"),
  plot.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein",
  x.title = "Sample group",
  y.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein"
  )
vf_hit_voilin[[1]]
vf_hit_voilin[[2]]
vf_hit_voilin_by_country <- create_cat_voilins(
  data = vf_hit_boot_res_by_country, 
  ci_offset = 0.3,
  file_name = "vf_perc_by_pop_netGen",
  plot_dir = paste0(figs_dir, "/vf"),
  cats_order = c("AUT", "AWC", "BMS", "ZAF", "ZAP",
                 "FJI", "MDG", "MEX", "NPL", "PER", "TZA",
                 "CHN", "DNK", "ESP", "USA"),
  plot.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein",
  x.title = "Sample origin",
  y.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein"
  )
vf_hit_voilin_by_country[[1]]
vf_hit_voilin_by_country[[2]]
vf_hit_voilin_downsampled <- create_cat_voilins(
  data = pal_size_vf_hit_boot_res_downsample, 
  ci_offset = c(0.15, 0.55, 0.55),
  file_name = "vf_perc_downsampled_netGen",
  plot_dir = paste0(figs_dir, "/vf"),
  cats_order = c("pal", "pre", "ind"),
  plot.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein",
  x.title = "Sample group",
  y.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs per selected protein"
  )
vf_hit_voilin_downsampled[[1]]
vf_hit_voilin_downsampled[[2]]

# test selected-contig prevalence differences among bootstrap distributions.
vf_hit <- reshape2::melt(vf_hit_boot_res)
kruskal.test(vf_hit$value, vf_hit$Var2)
vf_hit_by_country <- reshape2::melt(vf_hit_boot_res_by_country)
kruskal.test(vf_hit_by_country$value, vf_hit_by_country$Var2)
vf_hit_downsampled <- reshape2::melt(pal_size_vf_hit_boot_res_downsample)
kruskal.test(vf_hit_downsampled$value, vf_hit_downsampled$Var2)
```

## Complete CheckV genome analysis

The complete-genome tables use `checkv_filter` plus `genome_id` as their
key. The report analyzes regenerated full-pool VFDB set B using the
unsuffixed inputs below and conservative trimming only. Every table must
carry full-pool set B provenance.

### Version-specific CheckV summaries

Sample prevalence pools qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs across retained genomes and
divides by the pooled count of all bacterial-mode Prokka CDS calls on those
genomes, including hypothetical and non-EC proteins. Each ORF is counted once
regardless of its number of qualifying hits. Hits require full-sequence
E-value ≤ `1e-10`, score ≥ `25`, and score ≥ `10 × bias`.

Each observation and bootstrap resampling unit is one sample. This cohort
contains samples with eligible conservative-trimmed CheckV genomes and differs
from the full contig cohort. Samples without retained genomes are excluded.
After pooling, samples must have more than five bacterial ORFs; eligible
zero-hit samples remain zero. The contig exclusions `pal.ENG_LG4560.69` and
`pal.AUT_2612` also apply here. Stages 4 and 4a require no rerun.

```{r versioned complete CheckV analysis, results='asis'}
# use regenerated set B tables and validate their provenance.
checkv.input.paths <- file.path(data_dir, c(
  metadata = "checkv_genome_metadata.csv",
  features = "checkv_genome_features.csv",
  vf.hits = "checkv_genome_vf_hits.csv",
  vf.stats = "checkv_genome_vf_stats.csv",
  qc = "checkv_genome_qc.csv"
))
names(checkv.input.paths) <- c(
  "metadata", "features", "vf.hits", "vf.stats", "qc"
)
bundle <- list(tag = "VFDB_setB", label = "VFDB set B")
checkv.required.columns <- list(
  metadata = c(
    "checkv_filter", "genome_id", "checkv_contig_id", "category",
    "origin", "sample", "genome_length", "checkv_lifestyle", "phatyp_lifestyle",
    "phagcn_family"
  ),
  features = c(
    "checkv_filter", "genome_id", "annotation", "feature_id", "start",
    "end", "strand", "ec_number", "vf_id", "full_seq_evalue",
    "full_seq_score", "full_seq_bias", "vf_description"
  ),
  vf.hits = c(
    "checkv_filter", "genome_id", "annotation", "feature_id", "vf_id"
  ),
  vf.stats = c(
    "checkv_filter", "genome_id", "checkv_contig_id", "category",
    "origin", "sample", "total_bacterial_orfs", "qualifying_vf_orfs",
    "vf_present",
    "vf_orf_prevalence"
  ),
  qc = c("checkv_filter", "metric", "value", "details")
)
analysis.categories <- c("pal", "pre", "ind")
conservative.filter <- "conservative"
checkv.figs.dir <- file.path(figs_dir, "checkv")
dir.create(checkv.figs.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

read.checkv.bundle <- function(bundle) {
  table.paths <- checkv.input.paths
  missing.paths <- table.paths[!file.exists(table.paths)]
  if (length(missing.paths) > 0) {
    stop(
      bundle$label,
      " is missing required files: ",
      paste(missing.paths, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  tables <- lapply(table.paths, read.csv, check.names = TRUE)
  for (table.name in names(tables)) {
    validate.vf.pool(tables[[table.name]], bundle$tag)
    missing.columns <- setdiff(
      checkv.required.columns[[table.name]],
      names(tables[[table.name]])
    )
    if (length(missing.columns) > 0) {
      stop(
        bundle$label,
        " ",
        table.name,
        " table is missing columns: ",
        paste(missing.columns, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }

  for (table.name in c("metadata", "vf.stats")) {
    key <- tables[[table.name]][c("checkv_filter", "genome_id")]
    if (anyDuplicated(key)) {
      stop(bundle$label, " has duplicate CheckV genome keys in ", table.name)
    }
  }
  return(tables)
}

write.checkv.table <- function(table, table.name, bundle) {
  output.path <- file.path(
    checkv.figs.dir,
    paste0(table.name, "_", bundle$tag, ".csv")
  )
  write.csv(table, output.path, row.names = FALSE)
  return(invisible(output.path))
}

cat("#### ", bundle$label, "\n\n", sep = "")
checkv.tables <- read.checkv.bundle(bundle)
checkv.tables <- lapply(
  checkv.tables,
  function(table) {
    if ("checkv_filter" %in% names(table)) {
      table <- table %>% filter(checkv_filter == conservative.filter)
    }
    return(table)
  }
)
if (nrow(checkv.tables$metadata) == 0 ||
    nrow(checkv.tables$vf.stats) == 0) {
  stop(bundle$label, " has no conservative-trimmed CheckV genomes")
}

checkv.metadata <- checkv.tables$metadata %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    checkv.lifestyle = checkv_lifestyle,
    phatyp.lifestyle = phatyp_lifestyle,
    phagcn.family = phagcn_family,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    genome.length = genome_length
  )
checkv.features <- checkv.tables$features %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    ec.number = ec_number,
    vf.id = vf_id
  )
checkv.vf.stats <- checkv.tables$vf.stats %>%
  rename(
    checkv.filter = checkv_filter,
    genome.id = genome_id,
    total.bacterial.orfs = total_bacterial_orfs,
    qualifying.vf.orfs = qualifying_vf_orfs,
    vf.orf.prevalence = vf_orf_prevalence
  )

metadata.keys <- checkv.metadata %>% select(checkv.filter, genome.id)
stats.keys <- checkv.vf.stats %>% select(checkv.filter, genome.id)
if (nrow(anti_join(metadata.keys, stats.keys)) > 0 ||
    nrow(anti_join(stats.keys, metadata.keys)) > 0) {
  stop(bundle$label, " has unmatched metadata and VF-stat genome keys")
}

identity.columns <- c(
  "checkv.filter", "genome.id", "checkv_contig_id", "category", "origin", "sample"
)
if (nrow(anti_join(
  checkv.vf.stats %>% select(all_of(identity.columns)),
  checkv.metadata %>% select(all_of(identity.columns)),
  by = identity.columns
)) > 0) {
  stop(bundle$label, " metadata and VF-stat sample identifiers disagree")
}

vf.plot.data <- checkv.vf.stats %>%
  left_join(
    checkv.metadata %>%
      select(
      checkv.filter,
      genome.id,
      phatyp.lifestyle,
      checkv.lifestyle
      ),
    by = c("checkv.filter", "genome.id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(vfdb.version = bundle$label, vfdb.version.tag = bundle$tag)
if (nrow(vf.plot.data) != nrow(checkv.vf.stats) ||
    anyDuplicated(vf.plot.data[c("checkv.filter", "genome.id")])) {
  stop(bundle$label, " VF-stat join duplicated genome rows")
}

lifestyle.confusion <- checkv.metadata %>%
  count(
    checkv.filter,
    category,
    origin,
    checkv.lifestyle,
    phatyp.lifestyle,
    name = "genomes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(vfdb.version = bundle$label, vfdb.version.tag = bundle$tag)
lifestyle.agreement <- checkv.metadata %>%
  mutate(
    checkv.lifestyle.normalized = normalize.checkv.lifestyle(checkv.lifestyle),
    phatyp.lifestyle.normalized = normalize.checkv.lifestyle(
      phatyp.lifestyle
    ),
    agrees = checkv.lifestyle.normalized == phatyp.lifestyle.normalized
  ) %>%
  count(checkv.filter, category, origin, agrees, name = "genomes") %>%
  mutate(vfdb.version = bundle$label, vfdb.version.tag = bundle$tag)
family.summary <- checkv.metadata %>%
  count(
    checkv.filter,
    category,
    origin,
    phatyp.lifestyle,
    phagcn.family,
    name = "genomes"
  ) %>%
  group_by(checkv.filter, category, origin, phatyp.lifestyle) %>%
  mutate(fraction = genomes / sum(genomes)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(vfdb.version = bundle$label, vfdb.version.tag = bundle$tag)

write.checkv.table(lifestyle.confusion, "lifestyle_confusion", bundle)
write.checkv.table(lifestyle.agreement, "lifestyle_agreement", bundle)
write.checkv.table(family.summary, "phagcn_family_summary", bundle)
print(lifestyle.confusion)
print(lifestyle.agreement)
print(family.summary)

lifestyle.agreement.plot <- lifestyle.agreement %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = checkv.filter, y = genomes, fill = agrees)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ origin, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "CheckV trimming filter",
    y = "Fraction of complete genomes",
    fill = "Lifestyle agrees",
    title = paste("CheckV and PhaTYP lifestyle agreement:", bundle$label)
  ) +
  theme_bw()
# family.plot <- family.summary %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = phagcn.family, y = genomes, fill = phatyp.lifestyle)) +
#   geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
#   facet_grid(category + origin ~ checkv.filter, scales = "free_y") +
#   labs(
#     x = "PhaGCN family",
#     y = "Complete genomes",
#     fill = "PhaTYP lifestyle",
#     title = paste("PhaGCN family assignments:", bundle$label)
#   ) +
#   theme_bw() +
#   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
versioned.plots <- list(
  lifestyle_agreement = lifestyle.agreement.plot
)
for (plot.name in names(versioned.plots)) {
  ggsave(
    file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(plot.name, "_", bundle$tag, ".svg")),
    plot = versioned.plots[[plot.name]],
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )
  print(versioned.plots[[plot.name]])
}


```

### Sample-level VF ORF prevalence

Observed plots show one point per eligible sample, including zeros. Bootstrap
plots summarize medians from 1,000 draws with replacement and 95% percentile
intervals. Balanced draws use the eligible paleofecal sample count for every
group. The Kruskal–Wallis tests below compare **bootstrap median distributions**;
they are not tests directly on the observed sample proportions. Constant and
all-zero bootstrap distributions are retained.
The exported sample table uses `sample.id` for the canonical identifier and
`sample` for the original bare identifier.

```{r sample-level CheckV VF prevalence, results='asis'}
# pool integer genome counts before calculating each sample's prevalence.
vf.sample.data <- prepare.checkv.sample.vf(vf.plot.data)
if (!all(analysis.categories %in% vf.sample.data$category)) {
  stop("Sample VF prevalence requires eligible samples in pal, pre, and ind")
}
write.checkv.table(vf.sample.data, "vf_sample_prevalence", bundle)
vf.sample.summary <- vf.sample.data %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    samples = n(), zero.hit.samples = sum(qualifying.vf.orfs == 0L),
    genomes = sum(genome.count),
    total.bacterial.orfs = sum(total.bacterial.orfs),
    qualifying.vf.orfs = sum(qualifying.vf.orfs), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(category, analysis.categories))
write.checkv.table(vf.sample.summary, "vf_sample_cohort", bundle)
print(knitr::kable(vf.sample.summary))

# keep the contig report's origin order, reporting absent countries explicitly.
vf.country.order <- c(
  "AUT", "AWC", "BMS", "ZAF", "ZAP", "FJI", "MDG", "MEX",
  "NPL", "PER", "TZA", "CHN", "DNK", "ESP", "USA"
)
vf.absent.countries <- setdiff(vf.country.order, vf.sample.data$origin)
if (length(vf.absent.countries) > 0L) {
  cat("\n\nCountries omitted because no eligible samples remain: ",
      paste(vf.absent.countries, collapse = ", "), ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (length(setdiff(vf.sample.data$origin, vf.country.order)) > 0L) {
  stop("Eligible sample origins are absent from the contig country order")
}
vf.country.order <- intersect(vf.country.order, vf.sample.data$origin)

# plot one observed value per sample by group and by origin.
vf.sample.observed.plots <- list()
for (group.column in c("category", "origin")) {
  group.order <- if (group.column == "category") {
    analysis.categories
  } else {
    vf.country.order
  }
  plot.data <- vf.sample.data %>%
    mutate(plot.group = factor(.data[[group.column]], levels = group.order))
  observed.plot <- ggplot(
    plot.data, aes(x = plot.group, y = vf.orf.prevalence)
  ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 123),
      shape = 21, fill = "grey70", color = "black", alpha = 0.55, size = 2
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Sample VF ORF prevalence: VFDB set B (conservative trimming)",
      x = if (group.column == "category") "Sample group" else "Sample origin",
      y = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs / all bacterial-mode Prokka ORFs"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  vf.sample.observed.plots[[group.column]] <- observed.plot
  ggsave(
    file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(
      "vf_sample_observed_by_", group.column, "_", bundle$tag, ".svg"
    )),
    plot = observed.plot, width = 10, height = 7
  )
  print(observed.plot)
}

# reset the seed so the sample analysis is independent of historical draws.
set.seed(123)
vf.sample.pal.size <- sum(vf.sample.data$category == "pal")
vf.sample.bootstraps <- list(
  group = bootstrap.checkv.sample.vf(
    vf.sample.data, "category", analysis.categories, max_iter
  ),
  country = bootstrap.checkv.sample.vf(
    vf.sample.data, "origin", vf.country.order, max_iter
  ),
  balanced = bootstrap.checkv.sample.vf(
    vf.sample.data, "category", analysis.categories, max_iter,
    resample.size = vf.sample.pal.size
  )
)
vf.sample.violin.plots <- list()
vf.sample.tests <- list()
for (summary.name in names(vf.sample.bootstraps)) {
  draws <- vf.sample.bootstraps[[summary.name]]
  draw.table <- draws %>%
    mutate(
      draw = row_number(), checkv.filter = conservative.filter,
      vfdb_version = bundle$tag, orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds"
    )
  write.checkv.table(
    draw.table, paste0("vf_sample_bootstrap_", summary.name), bundle
  )
  group.order <- colnames(draws)
  violin.result <- create_cat_voilins(
    data = draws,
    ci_offset = if (summary.name == "country") 0.3 else c(0.15, 0.55, 0.55),
    file_name = paste0("vf_sample_", summary.name, "_", bundle$tag),
    plot_dir = checkv.figs.dir,
    cats_order = group.order,
    plot.title = paste(
      "Bootstrap median sample VF prevalence:", summary.name,
      "\nVFDB set B (conservative trimming)"
    ),
    x.title = if (summary.name == "country") "Sample origin" else "Sample group",
    y.title = "Qualifying VFDB-hit ORFs / all bacterial-mode Prokka ORFs"
  )
  vf.sample.violin.plots[[summary.name]] <- violin.result[[1]]
  print(violin.result[[1]])
  interval.table <- violin.result[[2]] %>%
    mutate(
      eligible.samples = vapply(as.character(cat), function(group.name) {
        column <- if (summary.name == "country") "origin" else "category"
        sum(vf.sample.data[[column]] == group.name)
      }, integer(1)),
      resample.size = if (summary.name == "balanced") {
        vf.sample.pal.size
      } else {
        eligible.samples
      },
      draws = max_iter, checkv.filter = conservative.filter,
      vfdb_version = bundle$tag, orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds"
    )
  write.checkv.table(
    interval.table, paste0("vf_sample_intervals_", summary.name), bundle
  )
  print(knitr::kable(interval.table))

  # preserve the selected contig procedure: test bootstrap median draws.
  test.data <- draws %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "group", values_to = "median")
  cat("\n\nKruskal–Wallis comparison of bootstrap median distributions: ",
      summary.name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (length(unique(test.data$median)) == 1L || ncol(draws) < 2L) {
    test.result <- tibble(
      summary = summary.name, statistic = NA_real_, df = ncol(draws) - 1L,
      p.value = NA_real_,
      note = "Undefined: all medians identical or fewer than two groups"
    )
  } else {
    test <- kruskal.test(median ~ group, data = test.data)
    print(test)
    test.result <- tibble(
      summary = summary.name, statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      df = unname(test$parameter), p.value = test$p.value,
      note = "Kruskal-Wallis test on bootstrap median distributions"
    )
  }
  vf.sample.tests[[summary.name]] <- test.result
}
write.checkv.table(
  bind_rows(vf.sample.tests), "vf_sample_bootstrap_kruskal_tests", bundle
)
print(knitr::kable(bind_rows(vf.sample.tests)))
```

### Genome VF presence and absence by CheckV lifestyle

Each bar counts all conservative-trimmed genomes in one category and CheckV
lifestyle group. VF-present genomes have at least one qualifying VFDB-hit ORF;
all other genomes are VF-absent. These descriptive genome counts do not apply
the sample-level eligibility filters above. Unknown lifestyle assignments are
excluded and reported below.

```{r genome VF presence absence, results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
# count each validated genome once using its CheckV-table lifestyle.
vf.genome.data <- vf.plot.data %>%
  mutate(lifestyle = normalize.checkv.lifestyle(checkv.lifestyle))
vf.genome.excluded <- vf.genome.data %>%
  filter(!lifestyle %in% c("lytic", "temperate")) %>%
  count(category, checkv.lifestyle, name = "excluded.genomes")
cat("\n\nGenomes excluded for unknown CheckV lifestyle: ",
    sum(vf.genome.excluded$excluded.genomes), ".\n\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(vf.genome.excluded) > 0L) {
  print(knitr::kable(vf.genome.excluded))
}
if (any(!vf.genome.data$category %in% analysis.categories)) {
  stop("Genome VF presence/absence has an unexpected category")
}

# complete both statuses; empty bars cannot be interpreted as proportions.
vf.genome.counts <- vf.genome.data %>%
  filter(lifestyle %in% c("lytic", "temperate")) %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = analysis.categories),
    lifestyle = factor(
      lifestyle, levels = c("lytic", "temperate"),
      labels = c("Lytic", "Temperate")
    ),
    vf.status = factor(
      if_else(qualifying.vf.orfs > 0L, "present", "absent"),
      levels = c("present", "absent")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(category, lifestyle, vf.status, name = "segment.count") %>%
  complete(category, lifestyle, vf.status, fill = list(segment.count = 0L)) %>%
  arrange(category, lifestyle, vf.status) %>%
  group_by(category, lifestyle) %>%
  mutate(bar.total = sum(segment.count)) %>%
  ungroup()
if (any(vf.genome.counts$bar.total == 0L)) {
  stop("Genome VF presence/absence requires genomes in every lifestyle bar")
}
vf.genome.counts <- vf.genome.counts %>%
  group_by(category, lifestyle) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = segment.count / bar.total,
    segment.top = cumsum(proportion),
    segment.bottom = segment.top - proportion,
    label.y = (segment.bottom + segment.top) / 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    fill.key = factor(
      paste(lifestyle, vf.status),
      levels = c(
        "Lytic present", "Lytic absent", "Temperate present",
        "Temperate absent"
      )
    ),
    bar.x = as.numeric(lifestyle),
    count.label = paste0("n = ", format(segment.count, trim = TRUE)),
    label.color = if_else(
      lifestyle == "Lytic" & segment.count > 0L, "white", "black"
    ),
    checkv.filter = conservative.filter,
    vfdb_version = bundle$tag,
    orf_pool = "all_bacterial_prokka_cds"
  )

# explicit rectangle bounds keep present below absent without stack defaults.
vf.genome.presence.plot <- ggplot(vf.genome.counts) +
  geom_rect(
    data = filter(vf.genome.counts, segment.count > 0L),
    aes(
      xmin = bar.x - 0.36, xmax = bar.x + 0.36,
      ymin = segment.bottom, ymax = segment.top, fill = fill.key
    ),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(vf.genome.counts, segment.count > 0L),
    aes(x = bar.x, y = label.y, label = count.label, color = label.color),
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(vf.genome.counts, segment.count == 0L),
    aes(
      x = bar.x, y = segment.bottom, label = count.label,
      vjust = if_else(vf.status == "present", 1.3, -0.3)
    ),
    color = "black", size = 3.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ category, switch = "x", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("Lytic", "Temperate"),
    limits = c(0.5, 2.5), expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(-0.06, 1.06), expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Lytic present" = "#08519C", "Lytic absent" = "#CB181D",
      "Temperate present" = "#9ECAE1", "Temperate absent" = "#FCAE91"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Proportion of genomes", fill = NULL,
    title = "Genome VF presence/absence by CheckV lifestyle",
    subtitle = "VFDB set B; conservative trimming"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# export the descriptive counts and plot with full-pool provenance.
vf.genome.output.stem <- paste0(
  "vf_genome_presence_absence_by_category_lifestyle_",
  bundle$tag, "_", conservative.filter
)
write.csv(
  vf.genome.counts %>%
    select(
      category, lifestyle, vf.status, segment.count, bar.total, proportion,
      checkv.filter, vfdb_version, orf_pool
    ),
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(vf.genome.output.stem, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
ggsave(
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0(vf.genome.output.stem, ".svg")),
  plot = vf.genome.presence.plot, width = 10, height = 7
)
print(vf.genome.presence.plot)
```


### Annotated maps of the top VF-bearing genomes

These maps rank the full conservative-trimmed genome pool by qualifying
VF-bearing ORF count, with genome ID breaking ties. Three genomes per category
are retained in `pal`, `pre`, `ind` order. Sample-prevalence exclusions and
minimum-denominator filters do not apply to this selection.

The supplemental `checkv_viral_cds_conservative.csv`, produced by stage 4a
from the existing viral Prokka GFF, contains **all** viral CDS, including
hypothetical proteins and proteins without EC numbers. VF calls come from the
separate bacterial-mode Prokka annotation and validated full-pool VFDB set B
search. Overlapping calls from these two prediction runs remain separate
features; matching feature IDs across runs does not imply matching ORFs.

Arrows retain original base-pair coordinates and point according to strand.
Each panel has its own scale covering position 1 through the full genome
length. Gray denotes viral CDS without EC annotations, blue denotes viral CDS
with EC annotations, and red denotes qualifying VF calls. Labels identify all
EC-bearing viral CDS and all VF calls, including features too narrow to contain
text. Annotation IDs use category and selected-genome rank, followed by `V`
(viral) or `F` (VF) and a coordinate-ordered index. They are deterministic for
the selected genomes and shared by both figures and the annotation tables.
Products and original VF descriptions are reproduced without inferring a
function for hypothetical proteins.

```{r top VF genome maps, results='asis', fig.width=15, fig.height=27}
# read the complete viral-CDS supplement; existing filtered exports stay intact.
viral.cds.path <- file.path(data_dir, "checkv_viral_cds_conservative.csv")
if (!file.exists(viral.cds.path)) {
  stop(
    "Missing checkv_viral_cds_conservative.csv: rerun stage 4a and copy ",
    "the supplemental CSV from the cluster data directory into data_dir."
  )
}
viral.cds <- read.csv(
  viral.cds.path, check.names = FALSE,
  colClasses = c(checkv_filter = "character", genome_id = "character",
                feature_id = "character", strand = "character",
                product = "character", ec_number = "character")
) %>%
  rename(checkv.filter = checkv_filter, genome.id = genome_id,
         ec.number = ec_number)
vf.genome.maps <- prepare.checkv.genome.maps(
  vf.plot.data, checkv.metadata, checkv.features, viral.cds
)
vf.top.genome.selection <- vf.genome.maps$selection
vf.top.genome.annotations <- vf.genome.maps$annotations
vf.top.genome.separate <- create.checkv.genome.map(
  vf.genome.maps, "separate_tracks"
)
vf.top.genome.overlay <- create.checkv.genome.map(vf.genome.maps, "overlay")

# export both views and their common selection and complete annotation tables.
vf.map.tag <- paste0("_", bundle$tag, "_", conservative.filter)
write.csv(
  vf.top.genome.selection,
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_top_genome_selection",
                                  vf.map.tag, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE, na = ""
)
write.csv(
  vf.top.genome.annotations,
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_top_genome_annotations",
                                  vf.map.tag, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE, na = ""
)
ggsave(
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_top_genome_maps_separate_tracks",
                                  vf.map.tag, ".svg")),
  plot = vf.top.genome.separate, width = 15, height = 27
)
ggsave(
  file.path(checkv.figs.dir, paste0("vf_top_genome_maps_overlay",
                                  vf.map.tag, ".svg")),
  plot = vf.top.genome.overlay, width = 15, height = 27
)
print(knitr::kable(vf.top.genome.selection, row.names = FALSE))
cat("\n\n")
print(vf.top.genome.separate)
print(vf.top.genome.overlay)

# print every plotted feature, keeping each genome's table together.
for (genome in vf.top.genome.selection$genome.id) {
  cat("\n\n#### ", genome, "\n\n", sep = "")
  # keep large annotation tables as raw HTML during Pandoc conversion.
  cat('\n\n```{=html}\n<div style="overflow-x: auto;">\n')
  print(knitr::kable(
    vf.top.genome.annotations %>% filter(genome.id == genome),
    row.names = FALSE, format = "html", escape = TRUE
  ))
  cat("\n</div>\n```\n\n")
}
```
